purpose: Additional region-defining skilling outfits, reward shops, and late-game tool chains found during the second regional skilling audit.

policy.region_rule: A regional acquisition route is useful planner information even when an alternate global minigame or currency source exists. Mark those rows as accessible rather than exclusive.
policy.outfit_rule: Track gameplay-obtainable skilling outfits and meaningful set effects. Treasure Hunter is never assumed as the League acquisition path.
policy.tool_chain_rule: Keep multi-region tool chains explicit instead of assigning the finished tool to whichever region contains the last crafting step.

activity_additions.name: Flash Powder Factory Herblore outfits
activity_additions.category: Herblore reward shop and outfit progression
activity_additions.location: Under the Pick and Lute in Taverley
unlocks: Botanist's outfit, up to 6% Herblore XP
Modified botanist's mask
Factory outfit
Three-piece factory effect: 10% chance to create a 4-dose potion instead of a 3-dose potion
Five-piece factory effect for unfinished-potion Herblore XP
activity_additions.notes: For self-sufficient Herblore, the factory set is more important than a plain XP outfit because three pieces change potion output. A common optimized setup mixes factory pieces with botanist pieces rather than wearing one full set for every potion.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Taverley is Asgarnia in the current region model. Do not assume Treasure Hunter acquisition for the botanist set.

activity_additions.name: Gnome Restaurant and sous chef's outfit
unlocks: Sous chef's outfit from hard deliveries
Up to 6% Cooking XP with the full outfit
activity_additions.notes: The gameplay acquisition route is hard Gnome Restaurant deliveries. This is a persistent Kandarin Cooking unlock even when a different region provides the fastest raw Cooking method.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Do not use Treasure Hunter as the acquisition path.

activity_additions.name: Ectofuntus and first age Prayer outfit
unlocks: First age outfit purchased for ecto-tokens
Up to 6% Prayer XP with the full outfit
Modified first age tiara after the base set
activity_additions.notes: The first age outfit is a permanent gameplay reward from the Ectofuntus route. Its XP boost does not apply while worshipping at the Ectofuntus itself, so the value is for Prayer training elsewhere.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Resolve normal Ghosts Ahoy access through the Equilibrium quest auto-completion overlay.

activity_additions.name: Archaeology Guild Shop and qualification upgrades
activity_additions.category: Archaeology shop, outfits, storage, precision and tool progression
activity_additions.location: Archaeology Campus at the Varrock Dig Site
unlocks: Archaeologist's outfit, up to 6% Archaeology XP
Master archaeologist's outfit at Guildmaster qualification
Master outfit: +7% excavation success, +7% screening success and +7% mattock base precision
Faster artefact restoration and soil screening
Longer Archaeology consumable durations
Unlimited dig-site and collector teleports from the master outfit
Material storage upgrades
Mattock precision upgrades
Auto-screener blueprint
Energised meteorite shard for the Mattock of Time and Space
activity_additions.notes: This is one of the strongest starting-region skilling infrastructure unlocks. Archaeology qualifications convert chronotes into permanent tool, storage, outfit and quality-of-life upgrades rather than only consumables.
activity_additions.league_treatment: The Archaeology Guild is in the starting Misthalin/Varrock bucket. Qualification and level requirements still apply unless a League rule overrides them.

requirements: Bring Austin a ghost impling jar to unlock the permanent shop

activity_additions.name: Runespan reward shop and master runecrafter robes
activity_additions.location: Runespan access from the Wizards' Tower
unlocks: Master runecrafter robes for Runespan points
5% Runecrafting XP with the full set
Runespan utility rewards and unstable essence
activity_additions.notes: Misthalin provides a direct self-sufficient route to the master runecrafter set through Runespan. The outfit is not a hard Misthalin exclusive because Great Orb Project tokens and thaler are alternate acquisition currencies.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Surface Misthalin as an acquisition route without turning it into a mandatory region dependency.

activity_additions.category: Farming permanent unlock shop and XP outfit
activity_additions.location: Garden of Kharid near Al Kharid
unlocks: Farmer's outfit pieces, up to 6% Farming XP
Bountiful Harvest
Speedy Growth

activity_additions.notes: Garden of Kharid is a major Desert skilling shop because its favour purchases permanent Farming and incense upgrades rather than only consumables. The regular farmer outfit also supplies the XP bonus inherited by higher-tier Farming outfit setups once owned.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Keep these unlocks separate from Kandarin Player-Owned Farm and master-farmer blueprint progression. The two regions provide different parts of Farming progression.

equipment_additions.name: Hatchet of Ember and Glade
equipment_additions.category: tier-90 augmentable Woodcutting tool cross-region chain
region_pressure: Crystal-hatchet progression is tied to Prifddinas crystal tools and a dragon hatchet base.
Dragon hatchets have a direct Dagannoth Kings source in the Fremennik region.
Imcando-hatchet fragments come from the tier-3 Woodcutter's Grove, currently mapped to Misthalin by historical League precedent.
The Shard of the Lumberjack is purchased from Wilfred north of Falador in Asgarnia.
Normal-game quest and dragon-forge requirements can add further access pressure and must be resolved through the Equilibrium quest overlay.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Do not assign the finished hatchet to one region. Its normal self-sufficient chain deliberately touches multiple region picks.

equipment_additions.name: Hatchet of Bloom and Blight
equipment_additions.category: tier-100 augmentable Woodcutting tool follow-on chain
requirements: Normal-game Kili Row and Pieces of Hate progression
effects: Designed as the highest-level Woodcutting hatchet and best XP/log-yield tool in its update tier
equipment_additions.notes: This inherits the full multi-region Ember and Glade chain before adding the tier-100 Ramarno and moonstone progression. Keep the component-level region map conservative until every 2026 League quest/access override is known.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Surface it as the late-game continuation of Ember and Glade without inventing a single-region requirement.
